complicacoes.texto: Eradicator is obsessed com preserving the culture e knowledge of the planet Krypton, no matter how little of it remains.

Eradicator loses his Poderes under a red sun. Other Efeitos draining or interfering com the energies of the yellow sun can deprive him of his Energia Raio, Voo, Super-Sentidos, Super-Velocidade, e Super-Força.
Eradicator is as Vulnerável to Magia as anyone else. His Resistência is not Impenetrável contra Mágico attacks.

Eradicator has a weakness to kryptonite, the radioactive remains of the planet Krypton. Kryptonite comes in a number of forms. Green kryptonite is by far the most common. Its Radiação saps his Força, Voo, Super-Sentidos, Super-Velocidade, e Super-Força, leaving him Prejudicado, Desabilitado, e eventually Debilitado in terms of Força e Poder Efeitos. Long-term exposure (usually a matter of minutes, less for a large enough amount) imposes the Moribundo condition e may lead to death. PERSONALITY The Eradicator is a Frio e dispassionate being, most often ruled by logic e his directive of preserving Kryptonian cul - ture e heritage. At times, David Connor’s personality has become dominant, giving the Eradicator a more human-like e emotional countenance. Poderes & Habilidades The Eradicator possesses all the Poderes e Habilidades of a Kryptonian exposed to yellow sun Radiação. In addition, he is able to manipulate Energia to produce various types of blasts, possesses a vast computer Intelecto, e is able to Detectar in - terdimensional beings e gateways. ALLIES The Eradicator has been allied com the Outsiders on occa - sion, e is considered part of Superman’s Estendido family. ENEMIES The Eradicator has at times directly opposed Superman.
